name: kb-capture
description: Daily capture for an Open Knowledge Format knowledge base: start-of-day briefs that pull your calendars and inbox, live meeting notes, Granola meeting transcripts matched against the calendar event, and voice notes — all filed into raw/ as normal sources. Ships the Granola MCP server; calendars, mail accounts and brief sections are configured per bundle in okf.toml's [capture] table, so nothing about your accounts is baked into the skill.
